WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    date_trunc('month', ORDERED_AT) AS month,
    SUM(SUBTOTAL) AS revenue
  FROM ORDERS
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', ORDERED_AT)
)
SELECT 
  month,
  revenue,
  LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prior_month_revenue,
  ROUND(((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100, 2) AS mom_growth_rate_pct
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month

SELECT 
  date_trunc('month', ORDERED_AT) AS month,
  SUM(SUBTOTAL) AS revenue,
  LAG(SUM(SUBTOTAL)) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('month', ORDERED_AT)) AS prior_month_revenue,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(SUBTOTAL) - LAG(SUM(SUBTOTAL)) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('month', ORDERED_AT))) 
    / LAG(SUM(SUBTOTAL)) OVER (ORDER BY date_trunc('month', ORDERED_AT)) * 100,
    2
  ) AS mom_growth_rate_pct
FROM ORDERS
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', ORDERED_AT)
ORDER BY month

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', ORDERED_AT) AS month, SUM(SUBTOTAL) AS revenue
  FROM ORDERS
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', ORDERED_AT)
)
SELECT 
  month,
  revenue,
  LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS previous_month_revenue,
  CASE 
    WHEN LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100, 2)
  END AS month_over_month_growth_rate_pct
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', ORDERED_AT) AS month,
        SUM(SUBTOTAL) AS revenue
    FROM ORDERS
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', ORDERED_AT)
),
with_growth AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        revenue,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT
    month,
    revenue,
    prev_revenue,
    ROUND(
        (revenue - prev_revenue) / prev_revenue * 100.0,
        2
    ) AS mom_growth_rate_pct
FROM with_growth
ORDER BY month

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', ORDERED_AT) AS month,

mom_growth AS (

        LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_revenue
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT
    month,
    revenue,
    prev_month_revenue,
    CASE
        WHEN prev_month_revenue IS NULL OR prev_month_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND((revenue - prev_month_revenue) / prev_month_revenue * 100, 2)
    END AS mom_growth_rate_pct
FROM mom_growth
ORDER BY month

SELECT

WITH customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT CUSTOMER_ID,
         COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM ORDERS
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
),
repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customer_count
  FROM customer_order_counts
  WHERE order_count >= 2
),
total_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customer_count
  FROM customer_order_counts
)
SELECT 100.0 * repeat_customer_count / total_customer_count AS repeat_customer_rate_pct
FROM repeat_customers, total_customers

         LAG(ORDERED_AT) OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY ORDERED_AT) AS prev_order_at,
         EXTRACT(DAY FROM ORDERED_AT - LAG(ORDERED_AT) OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY ORDERED_AT)) AS days_between
  FROM ORDERS
),

  SELECT CUSTOMER_ID,
         AVG(days_between) AS avg_days_between
  FROM customer_order_pairs
  WHERE days_between IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
)

         DATE_DIFF('day', LAG(CREATED_AT) OVER (PARTITION BY USER_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT), CREATED_AT) AS DAY_GAP
  FROM ORDERS
),
per_customer AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, AVG(DAY_GAP) AS AVG_GAP
  FROM gaps
  WHERE DAY_GAP IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY USER_ID
)
SELECT AVG(AVG_GAP) AS AVG_DAYS_BETWEEN_ORDERS
FROM per_customer

  FROM ORDERS
),
PER_CUSTOMER AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, AVG(GAP_DAYS) AS AVG_GAP
  FROM GAPS
  WHERE GAP_DAYS IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY USER_ID
)
SELECT AVG(AVG_GAP) AS AVG_DAYS_BETWEEN_ORDERS

WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, CREATED_AT,
         LAG(CREATED_AT) OVER (PARTITION BY USER_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT) AS prev_order_date
  FROM ORDERS
),
days_between AS (
  SELECT USER_ID,
         EXTRACT(DAY FROM CREATED_AT - prev_order_date) AS days_elapsed
  FROM customer_orders
  WHERE prev_order_date IS NOT NULL
),
avg_per_customer AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, AVG(days_elapsed) AS avg_days
  FROM days_between
  GROUP BY USER_ID
)
SELECT AVG(avg_days) AS avg_days_between_consecutive_orders
FROM avg_per_customer

WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, CREATED_AT,
         LAG(CREATED_AT) OVER (PARTITION BY USER_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT) AS prev_order_date
  FROM ORDERS
),
customer_gaps AS (
  SELECT USER_ID,
         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CREATED_AT - prev_order_date)) / 86400.0 AS days_between
  FROM customer_orders
  WHERE prev_order_date IS NOT NULL
),
customer_avg_gaps AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, AVG(days_between) AS avg_days_between
  FROM customer_gaps
  GROUP BY USER_ID
)
SELECT AVG(avg_days_between) AS avg_days_between_consecutive_orders
FROM customer_avg_gaps

  p.CATEGORY,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.RETURNED_AT IS NOT NULL THEN o.ORDER_ID END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_ID), 0) AS return_rate

         COALESCE(T.PRODUCT_CATEGORY_NAME_ENGLISH, P.PRODUCT_CATEGORY_NAME) AS CATEGORY,
         SUM(OI.PRICE) AS BUSINESS_VOLUME
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS OI
  JOIN ORDERS O ON OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID
  JOIN CUSTOMERS C ON O.CUSTOMER_ID = C.CUSTOMER_ID
  JOIN PRODUCTS P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID
  LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_CATEGORY_NAME_TRANSLATION T
    ON P.PRODUCT_CATEGORY_NAME = T.PRODUCT_CATEGORY_NAME
  WHERE O.ORDER_STATUS = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY C.CUSTOMER_STATE, CATEGORY
),
RANKED AS (
  SELECT CUSTOMER_STATE,
         CATEGORY,
         BUSINESS_VOLUME,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_STATE
           ORDER BY BUSINESS_VOLUME DESC, CATEGORY
         ) AS RN
  FROM CAT_BV
)

       BUSINESS_VOLUME

        CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID,
        ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP,
        LAG(ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP) OVER (
            PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
            ORDER BY ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP
        ) AS prev_order_ts
    FROM customer_orders
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT
        CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID,
        DATE_DIFF('day', prev_order_ts, ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP) AS days_between
    FROM with_lag
    WHERE prev_order_ts IS NOT NULL
),
avg_per_customer AS (
    SELECT
        CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID,
        AVG(days_between) AS avg_days_between_orders
    FROM gaps
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
)
SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(avg_days_between_orders), 2) AS avg_days_between_consecutive_orders
FROM avg_per_customer

WITH person_orders AS (
  SELECT c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID AS PERSON,
         o.ORDER_ID,
         o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP AS PURCHASE_TS
  FROM ORDERS o
  JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT PERSON,
         date_diff('day',
           LAG(PURCHASE_TS) OVER (PARTITION BY PERSON ORDER BY PURCHASE_TS),
           PURCHASE_TS) AS GAP_DAYS
  FROM person_orders
),
per_person AS (
  SELECT PERSON, AVG(GAP_DAYS) AS AVG_GAP
  FROM gaps
  WHERE GAP_DAYS IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY PERSON
)
SELECT AVG(AVG_GAP) AS AVG_DAYS_BETWEEN_CONSECUTIVE_ORDERS
FROM per_person

WITH today AS (SELECT DATE '2026-05-30' AS d),
period_spend AS (
    SELECT
        c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP >= (SELECT d FROM today) - INTERVAL 90 DAY
                 THEN oi.PRICE ELSE 0 END) AS spend_last_90,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP >= (SELECT d FROM today) - INTERVAL 180 DAY
                  AND o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP < (SELECT d FROM today) - INTERVAL 90 DAY
                 THEN oi.PRICE ELSE 0 END) AS spend_prior_90
    FROM ORDERS o
    JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
    JOIN ORDER_ITEMS oi ON o.ORDER_ID = oi.ORDER_ID
    WHERE o.ORDER_STATUS = 'delivered'
      AND o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP >= (SELECT d FROM today) - INTERVAL 180 DAY
    GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_spent_more_last_90
FROM period_spend
WHERE spend_last_90 > spend_prior_90

  FROM ORDER_ITEMS oi
  JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
  JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
  WHERE o.ORDER_STATUS = 'delivered'
    AND o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP >= CAST('2026-05-30' AS DATE) - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
),
prior_90_days AS (
  SELECT c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID, SUM(oi.PRICE) AS spend_prior_90
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS oi
  JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
  JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
  WHERE o.ORDER_STATUS = 'delivered'
    AND o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP >= CAST('2026-05-30' AS DATE) - INTERVAL 180 DAY
    AND o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP < CAST('2026-05-30' AS DATE) - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
),
combined AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(l.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID, p.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID) AS customer_id,
         COALESCE(l.spend_last_90, 0) AS spend_last_90,
         COALESCE(p.spend_prior_90, 0) AS spend_prior_90
  FROM last_90_days l
  FULL OUTER JOIN prior_90_days p ON l.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID = p.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
)

WHERE spend_last_90 > spend_prior_90
